name: commitflow-ai
description: One keyboard shortcut to pull, stage, commit with an AI-generated message, and push your Git changes automatically.

commands.title: CommitFlow AI: Set API Key (for Active Provider)
CommitFlow AI: Clear API Key (for Active Provider)

enumDescriptions: Use OpenRouter to generate commit messages.
Use Amazon Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
commitflow-ai.provider.description: AI provider used to generate commit messages.

commitflow-ai.openrouterModel.description: OpenRouter model used to generate commit messages (used when commitflow-ai.provider is "openrouter").

commitflow-ai.bedrockRegion.description: AWS region of the Bedrock Mantle (OpenAI-compatible) endpoint (used when commitflow-ai.provider is "bedrock").

commitflow-ai.bedrockModel.description: Bedrock model ID used to generate commit messages (used when commitflow-ai.provider is "bedrock").

enumDescriptions: type: short description (e.g. "feat: add dark mode toggle"), using types like feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, style, build.
A short, plain-language summary of the change with no type prefix (e.g. "add dark mode toggle").
A longer, more explanatory summary that gives extra context about what changed and why, still within the max length.

commitflow-ai.fallbackCommitMessage.description: Optional commit message used if AI generation fails. Leave empty to stop instead of committing when AI generation fails.

commitflow-ai.maxFullDiffBytes.description: Maximum staged diff size for sending the full diff to the AI.

commitflow-ai.maxReducedDiffBytes.description: Maximum staged diff size before switching to a structured summary.
